title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Dry Eyes
intro: Herbal creams for dry eyes are topical creams made from natural ingredients, such as herbs, plants, and essential oils, designed to soothe and moisturize the eyes to alleviate dry eye symptoms. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat dry eyes include reduced inflammation, improved tear quality, and enhanced eye comfort. Examples of herbal creams used to treat dry eyes include Eyebright cream, which helps to reduce puffiness and redness, and N-Acetyl Cysteine (NAC) cream, which supports the health of the meibomian glands. Other examples include Licorice root cream, which helps to soothe and calm the eyes, and Aloe vera cream, which provides hydration and anti-inflammatory properties to the eyes.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat dry eyes due to their anti-inflammatory and soothing properties, which help to reduce redness and irritation. The bioactive constituents, including triterpenoids and carotenoids, in Calendula officinalis creams exert their beneficial effects by reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and protecting the ocular surface. By applying Calendula officinalis creams to the affected area, individuals with dry eyes can experience relief from discomfort, improved tear quality, and enhanced eye health. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis creams to treat dry eyes include reduced reliance on artificial tears, improved tear production, and a decrease in the risk of eye infections.

Symphytum officinale creams, derived from the plant Symphytum officinale, also known as comfrey, are used to treat the dry eyes ailment due to their anti-inflammatory and soothing properties. The herbal preparation helps to treat this ailment by reducing inflammation, promoting healing, and moisturizing the eyes. The bioactive constituents of Symphytum officinale creams, including allantoin, rosmarinic acid, and flavonoids, play a crucial role in treating dry eyes by reducing inflammation and promoting the integrity of the ocular surface. The benefits of using Symphytum officinale creams to treat dry eyes include reduced eye irritation, improved tear production, and enhanced comfort, making it a popular natural remedy for this condition.

The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of ginkgo biloba creams also help to protect the eyes from further damage, promoting long-term eye health.

preparations.preparation_study: According to the "Journal of the Indian Medical Association", Aloe vera creams for dry eyes were found to be more effective than placebo in improving symptoms in patients with dry eye syndrome.
